title: PACA architecture
brief: A high level architecture image for the public README of PACA, the personal assistant of a one-person business: the agent, the custom MCP servers, the main database, the memory of the agent and the Telegram channel that exists today.

artboards.title: Editorial river
artboards.tradeoff: Purple-dominant and editorial: black ink, brown warmth, the flow of the business reads left to right

artboards.title: Blueprint
artboards.tradeoff: Black canvas, purple and brown; technical and precise, with the protocols on every edge, at the cost of the warmth of the first board

artboards.title: Layered stack
artboards.tradeoff: The clearest reading of the whole system, layer by layer; less of a narrative, more of a map
